entries.en: Got a scavenger problem around here?
entries.ro: Aveți probleme cu hienele pe aici?

entries.en: Lookin' to buy some new iron, a few dozen pounds.
entries.ro: Caut ceva fier nou, vreo câteva zeci de kile.

entries.en: Scavs give you a lot of trouble around here?
entries.en_m: Scavs give you a lot of trouble 'round here?
entries.ro: Hienele îți dau multe bătăi de cap pe aici?

entries.en: Some days, sure, other days... eh, not so much. But me, personally – well... they know better.
entries.ro: Unele zile, da, altele... ăăă, nu prea. Da' eu, personal – păi... ei știu mai bine.
